name: CombinePolygons
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesArrText,[count],LET(i, IF(ISOMITTED(count), 1, count), n, ROWS(verticesArrText), cVerticesText, INDEX(verticesArrText, i, 1), otherVertices, {ref}RemoveRow(verticesArrText, i), verticesArrText_updated, {ref}Loop_CombinePolygons(cVerticesText, otherVertices), isCombined, ROWS(verticesArrText_updated) < n, output, IF(OR(i = n, ROWS(verticesArrText_updated) = 1), verticesArrText_updated, IF(isCombined, CombinePolygons(verticesArrText_updated, 1), CombinePolygons(verticesArrText, i + 1))), output))
comment: To combine multiple polygons. Last update at 2024-07-06.
